_source: Extracted from conflict_310726_2216 branch (Aug 2026). Canonical design tokens for the OnCall Foot brand. Palette, typography and component rules are live in artifacts/web/src/index.css and artifacts/mobile.

colors.vibe: Trust, Growth, Calm. Grounded, matte, physical.
rules: Use Sage green (primary) for primary actions and highlights.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Use tinted charcoal for text.
Maintain WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast for small text, 3:1 for large text.
Explicitly set text color on hover states.

surfaces: Neumorphism (Tactile) variant for dashboard widgets: Off-white background, subtle soft shadows, 1px border-black/5 to ground it.
Glassmorphism (Crystal) for sticky bottom navigation: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-black/5.
shadows: shadow-md for floating elements or active states

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or highly rounded (rounded-xl) with scale-95 on active. Min height 44px (h-11) for mobile tap targets.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift and shadow.
components.chips: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold. Colors based on status (e.g. green for confirmed, yellow/orange for pending).
components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, z-50, flex justify-around items-center h-16 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t. Contains: Home, Bookings, Services, Earnings, Profile. Use Lucide icons.

layouts.container: w-full min-h-screen bg-background pb-20 md:pb-0 md:flex
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-4 to p-6 for main sections. gap-4 or gap-6 for lists.
layouts.headers: Sticky top headers with page title, background white/80 backdrop-blur-md, z-40.
layouts.dashboard_home: Progressive disclosure. Top-priority metric first (e.g., Today's Appointments). Action blocks for next steps.
layouts.bookings_list: Card stack. 3-5 priority KPIs per card. Status chips. Large touch targets.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion optional, but simple CSS opacity/transform transitions for tabs/routes.
motion.interactions: Hover and active states on all touchable elements. `transition-transform duration-200 active:scale-95`.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for booking lists.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="booking-accept-btn"`).

media.icons: lucide-react for all standard UI icons.
media.images: Use provided URLs for onboarding background and dummy avatars. Object-cover, max-h-[80vh] for hero images.

onboarding_hero.description: A therapist providing a serene foot massage for relaxation in a modern spa setting. Use in the onboarding screen to set the wellness mood.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Tailwind/HTML for layout shells, but strictly use Shadcn UI components for interactive logic (Forms, Dialogs, Select, Calendar).
Add font links for Manrope and DM Sans in index.html or global css.
Configure Tailwind config and CSS variables with the provided Organic & Earthy Sage palette.
Implement the bottom navigation bar clearly visible on mobile viewports. On desktop, this can transform to a sidebar or stay bottom nav within a mobile-width container.
Create realistic dummy data for the dashboard (appointments, earnings, reviews).
Ensure all interactive elements have a minimum 44px tap target height (h-11 or p-3).
Never center text on dense data pages like Bookings or Earnings. Left-align for scannability.
Implement clear status chips for bookings (e.g., Pending, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled).
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is banned.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
